summary: Controller node types are control, hybrid, execution and hop, each with 16 GB RAM, 4 vCPU and 3000 IOPS minimum. Execution nodes run jobs (scale for forks), control nodes process events and project updates (80 GB, 20 GB in `/var/lib/awx`), hybrid nodes do both, and hop nodes route mesh traffic, where latency matters more than RAM or CPU.
questions: What are the automation controller node types?
What is the difference between control and hybrid nodes?
How do I size execution nodes for more forks?
